learning_objective: 🏛️ Discover the vast tree of art! Learn the difference between art made just for beauty (Fine Arts) and art made to be used (Applied Arts).

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: ललित कला (सौंदर्य और आत्म-अभिव्यक्ति के लिए बनाई गई कला)
व्यावहारिक कला (दैनिक जीवन की उपयोगी वस्तुओं को सुंदर बनाने की कला)
वास्तुकला (भवनों और इमारतों का डिज़ाइन बनाने की कला और विज्ञान)
ग्राफिक डिज़ाइन (दृश्य और पाठ्यांश/Text के जरिए संदेश संप्रेषित करने की कला)
हस्तशिल्प (हाथों से बनाई गई सजावटी और उपयोगी पारंपरिक वस्तुएं)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Fine Arts are created purely for aesthetic (beauty) or intellectual value. The artist creates them to express emotions or ideas. Examples include Painting, Sculpture, and Printmaking. You don't 'use' a painting; you just look at it.

Applied Arts involve designing everyday, functional objects to make them look visually pleasing. The primary purpose is utility. Examples include Industrial Design (designing a cool-looking car or chair), Fashion Design, and Interior Design.

The ultimate mix of art and science! Architecture is the process of planning, designing, and constructing buildings. It must be highly functional, structurally safe, and aesthetically beautiful (like the Taj Mahal or a modern skyscraper).

Commercial art is created for advertising and selling products. Graphic design is a major part of this—it combines text, typography, and images to communicate a specific message (like designing a movie poster, a company logo, or a website).
Handicrafts are functional and decorative items made entirely by hand using traditional skills passed down through generations. Examples include pottery, weaving, basketry, and jewelry making.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 Art Hunt in Your Room
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room right now and identify 1 example of Fine Art (like a painting or poster on the wall) and 2 examples of Applied Art (like the design of your sneakers, the shape of your lamp, or the graphic design on a cereal box)!

exam_tips: 📌 The main difference: Fine Arts exist for aesthetic appreciation and emotional expression. Applied Arts exist to make functional, everyday objects look beautiful.
📌 Graphic design heavily uses 'Typography' (the art of arranging text/fonts).
📌 Architecture is often considered the 'Mother of all arts' because an architect's building houses sculptures, paintings, and interior designs.
quick_recap: ⭐ Photography can be both a Fine Art (artistic landscapes) and a Commercial Art (product photos for a magazine).
⭐ Applied arts include Fashion Design, Interior Design, and Industrial Design.
⭐ The lines between Fine Art and Applied Art have blurred in modern times as everyday designs become highly artistic.
